batch.title: Workforce roster and check-in
batch.goal: Complete assignment, roster, schedule publication, acknowledgement, conflict handling, replacement, notification, and check-in.
exitCriteria: Admin-to-worker assignment, notification, acknowledgement, roster, replacement, and check-in journeys pass.
Cross-organization, forged status, revoked user, duplicate, partial failure, and retry cases fail safely.

findings.title: Conflict detection blind to venue-employed staff; derived-only unpersisted
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

specTasks.title: Map existing person/assignment records
acceptanceCriteria: Each roster/team/participant/staff/employment/Work Mode field has canonical destination and identity-resolution rule; duplicate risk report is generated.

specTasks.title: Add organization and assignment authority
acceptanceCriteria: All workforce records have org scope; server commands validate tour/event/role parents; protected fields use field-level projections.

specTasks.title: Create canonical assignment service
acceptanceCriteria: Tour/event panels, scheduling, hiring conversion, calendar, and Work Mode use the same person/role/assignment identity and status transitions.

specTasks.title: Remove demo availability/templates from live mode
acceptanceCriteria: Live organizations use persisted records only; demo fixtures are isolated by environment/account and visibly labeled.

specTasks.title: Add identity merge/reconciliation
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized workflow identifies likely duplicates, previews references, merges safely, retains audit/aliases, and never auto-merges on weak signals.

specTasks.title: Create tour party model
acceptanceCriteria: Members have scoped dates, role/department, assignment status, traveler attributes, Work Mode link, and restricted personal-field access.

specTasks.title: Build tour-wide staffing matrix
acceptanceCriteria: Rows/columns support roles, people, stops/days, coverage, open positions, conflicts, and filters; travel/non-venue days are first-class.

specTasks.title: Add role/headcount templates
acceptanceCriteria: Organization-owned versioned templates define required roles/counts by event type/scale and can be applied with preview, not silent creation.

specTasks.title: Add availability and time-off
acceptanceCriteria: Workers/managers enter intervals/recurrence with time zone and approval/source; scheduling conflict engine uses persisted truth.

specTasks.title: Add skills and credentials
acceptanceCriteria: Roles declare requirements; worker credentials have issuer/expiry/verification/files; missing/expiring requirements block or warn by policy.

specTasks.title: Add labor/rest rule profiles
acceptanceCriteria: Configurable jurisdiction/contract templates detect turnaround, meal/rest, consecutive days, overlap, and travel-work conflicts with documented assumptions.

specTasks.title: Add schedule templates
acceptanceCriteria: Versioned templates derive calls from event milestones or fixed local times; preview shows shifts, unresolved roles, conflicts, and estimated cost.

specTasks.title: Generate shifts transactionally
acceptanceCriteria: Bulk generation is idempotent, supports event/travel/rehearsal/warehouse/other days, respects locked edits, and returns complete item-level result.

specTasks.title: Add assignment workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Draft/offered/accepted/declined/confirmed/released/cancelled states, reason, deadlines, reminders, replacement workflow, and audit are implemented.

specTasks.title: Add conflict resolution UI
acceptanceCriteria: Conflict explains rule/evidence/severity/affected assignments and supports authorized override with reason or direct remediation.

specTasks.title: Add labor cost forecast
acceptanceCriteria: Rate card, overtime/premium assumptions, travel/per diem, estimated hours, currency, and committed/actual forecast feed budget without exposing rates broadly.

specTasks.title: Publish schedules through publication service
acceptanceCriteria: Recipient receives exact version/diff, local times, locations/calls, and acknowledgement; failure/retry state is visible.

specTasks.title: Capture attendance and actual time
acceptanceCriteria: Check-in/out/manual correction with reason/approval, offline recovery, and audit; planned shifts remain versioned.

specTasks.title: Add payroll/time export
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized, approved period exports stable worker/shift/rate/cost identifiers and adjustments; reruns are versioned and reconcile totals.

specTasks.title: Workforce SLO/alerts
acceptanceCriteria: Monitor uncovered critical roles, expiring credentials, overdue responses/onboarding, notification failure, conflict backlog, and identity sync failure.

specTasks.title: Complete migration and retire duplicates
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical assignments reconcile to legacy counts/references; old writes stop; compatibility views then code/tables are retired by approved retention plan.

workflows.title: Workforce Scheduling, Roster, and Check-In

producer.outcome: Assigns, publishes, and updates organization workforce shifts.

recipients.outcome: Receives the assignment, responds, and checks in/out.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Organization-owned shifts remain protected even without a venue; conflicts and assignments use the employer entity and target event.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: Admin and Worker see the same assignment state, including decline, cancel, replacement, and check-in.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

references.canonicalSource: Authenticated acting-context and capability command wrappers
invariants: Organization and actor context come from trusted server state.
Every mutation declares capability, target, validation, idempotency, audit, and stable errors.

references.canonicalSource: Shared Admin page header and explicit loading, empty, error, and permission states
invariants: Live Admin UI contains no mock or synthetic operational data.
Every surface provides accessible loading, empty, error, denied, success, and recovery behavior as applicable.

launchGates.title: Admin to Worker journey passes
launchGates.acceptance: Posting through check-in and recipient acknowledgement passes without soft assertions.
